column1: # Experimental (procedural talk): values for the subtitle slots in the english column, like {thing}.
# The audio never says these words. One pool per name, one value per row. A value may hold slots itself,
# so a pool can be a list of whole sentences. Every value must read well in every sentence that uses the
# pool (the comment above a pool shows a few). Things from KSP work best. Used by build_lonapse.py and the plugin.
# thing: Who took my X? / Next to my X. / Bet you my X. / You still owe me a X. (singular, no vowel at the start)
# spot: Look behind the X. / Try the X. / Last time it was under the X. (inside the cabin, in reach)
# part: The X came loose again. / Tape it, like the X. / That was the X. (inside the cabin, in reach)
# outside_part: It's the X. Probably. / Control, the X is shaking. (outside: only when the vessel has one)
# beeper: Why is the X beeping?
# food: Is that X? / Someone ate all the X. / Eat the X. It builds character. / Can you send us some X?
# creature: Last night I dreamt about X. It knew my name.
